definition: טָֽבְאֵל proper name, masculine (Aramaic; = God is good , see טוֺב ; according to Wkl (see below) God is wise , compare Aramaic , Ethiopic be wise ; Arabic act as physician , expert ) — Persian officer in Samaria Ezra 4:7 , ᵐ5 Ταβεηλ .
